form.ulKindHelper: Decides what the flights count toward. Three-axis ultralight time and landings count toward EASA SEP (Land) revalidation and LAPL(A) recency, a UL motorglider's toward TMG, but not the instructor flight. German UL recency is kept per kind.
form.maxTakeoffMassHelper: Ultralight gyroplanes of at least 450 kg count toward EASA GPL recency time and landings (FCL.035(a)(5)).
